data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **1Password Business is my top recommendation**\. It offers an excellent balance of security, ease of use, shared credentials, and administrative controls without making password management feel like an IT project.

If you're choosing a password manager for a team of roughly 3–25 people, I'd shortlist four options.

## Best options for a small team

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My recommendation)

- Excellent desktop, mobile and browser apps.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy onboarding and employee offboarding.
- Security alerts and administrative reporting.

Best if you want something polished that employees will actually use.

Teams Starter Pack: approximately US\$24.95/month for up to 10 people. Business has additional controls. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![‎Bitwarden App - App Store](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/x38pyi5v1Vy6Zs97qz8ZgS0U3TY6bP46EZUol0vjWY-QJEsjpBL1sBYpo0AxExRZj59SXzc9D5J1hCMKpLCQRKtRmi0IYkc0CeiDQsrny4xPWuRz2OGsqZ9tyuMm4GtN5vMAwBBf6hXgHDHMP9_wXSBVttW9bXO5pQrWG4hhS-RxRNQIRTsbPrqb3y45Jv-M?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source core.
- Shared collections and organization management.
- Audit and event logs.
- Good cross-platform support.

Best if you want strong functionality at a lower price.

Teams: approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![‎Keeper Password Manager App - App Store](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6YqDIYCwAfpd6GObzC-G1I_Ae64PhD3Adg6yFTCDbBzmw2aNf2KsneQTuxazrol31Rc6ACKK3x9Eh1luvNAHDI1r711RPuAeW2f0aAFmjVsqzUYe4jhRFTDwXTW7NUhBUV3qqwhS9yrU3ZD-hUKGwId-qbRcNIdL4KiaJcX6Q-NTBSa05phiAGYremJ0qUvL?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for administration**

- Shared team folders.
- Role-based access controls.
- Delegated administration.
- Additional security and compliance features.

Best if you need more structured access management.

Business Starter: approximately US\$2/user/month, subject to plan limits. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Proton Pass: Password Manager | F-Droid - Repositório de aplicativos Android livres e de código aberto](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/TSyfLItegVODYpTj4lUAeHKj3L41BqMVHFFCpNLHUlZA2z3u4PXyGGkyucx18o9OhDidoL7QLU1cmJ_VpThs9wkbWvfn2ZWD2j29U2MH5G7lW7l8wMViM0r2RoRpwSRxtDdco-rePLL5eY9xTBh-6733sXpFghwi_qbSxOtJ7xx0z_8y0u08JBUtsn4qBm-G?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass — Best privacy-focused alternative**

- End-to-end encrypted credential storage.
- Secure sharing.
- Aliases for email privacy.
- Attractive option for privacy-conscious teams.

Best if privacy is a particularly important consideration.

[Proton Pass for business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good |
| Team sharing | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good |
| Budget-friendly | Good | Excellent |
| Open source | No | Yes |


For a small business, I would prioritize shared vaults, individual employee accounts, two-factor authentication, access revocation, and emergency account recovery. Avoid sharing one master password across the entire team.

## What I'd choose

- **3–10 employees\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack.
- **10–25 employees\:** 1Password Business or Bitwarden Teams.
- **Very tight budget\:** Bitwarden Teams.
- **More demanding security administration\:** Keeper or 1Password Business.

One additional consideration: since you're in Canada, check data residency requirements before purchasing. 1Password offers a Canadian data region and CAD billing options. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
